light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: The place is a small bedroom in a modest Latin American house: the wall on the left is painted with old glossy cream latex paint, the wall on the right is bare grey cement plaster not yet painted, a window with an aluminium frame letting in daylight, a bed pushed aside and covered with an old sheet, a plastic sheet on the tiled floor, a chair with folded clothes. Light: daylight through the window plus a plain ceiling bulb; correctly exposed, the side near the window brighter. The presenter is a man of about 50 with black curly hair and a short salt-and-pepper beard (exactly the face of the last input image), wearing a faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, stained with white paint and dust, a worn brown leather apron over it, and dark work trousers. He stands beside the old cream latex wall; on it there is a small square test patch of dried white limewash with a strip of masking tape pressed on it.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: he stands beside the old cream latex wall, his knuckles against it, looking at the camera. He is still wearing the faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up and the worn brown leather apron tied over it, exactly as in the first image.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: he holds up the strip of tape toward the camera, the tape covered in white flakes, a bare patch visible on the wall. He is still wearing the faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up and the worn brown leather apron tied over it, exactly as in the first image.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: he points at the flaking test patch on the cream latex wall, serious face at the camera. He is still wearing the faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up and the worn brown leather apron tied over it, exactly as in the first image.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: water drops bead and run down the glossy cream wall, he points at them looking at the camera. He is still wearing the faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up and the worn brown leather apron tied over it, exactly as in the first image.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: a dark damp spot on the bare grey plaster where the drops soaked in, he points at it with a satisfied face. He is still wearing the faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up and the worn brown leather apron tied over it, exactly as in the first image.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: a curl of cream paint hangs from the putty knife, a patch of bare grey plaster exposed, he looks at the camera. He is still wearing the faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up and the worn brown leather apron tied over it, exactly as in the first image.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: he rests a hand on the smooth white gypsum wall, shaking his head slightly at the camera. He is still wearing the faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up and the worn brown leather apron tied over it, exactly as in the first image.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the hands and materials only, same place and same light as the first input image, the face is not in the frame (ignore the last input image): close view of water drops beading and sliding down a glossy cream painted wall.
Same extreme close-up, same framing, same light, a few seconds later: the drops leaving thin shiny trails down the glossy paint.

clips.text: Y la tercera: ¿la puedo poner encima de la pintura que ya tengo? Aquí está la parte honesta.
clips.action: he stands in a small bedroom next to a wall painted with old glossy cream latex paint and knocks on it.

clips.text: Sobre látex, esmalte o pintura plástica, se agarra mal. Mira la cinta: se llevó todo.
clips.action: he presses a strip of masking tape on a small test patch of dried limewash on the latex wall and pulls it off.

clips.text: La cal necesita un fondo mineral para meterse: repello, ladrillo, cemento. El plástico no la deja entrar.
clips.action: he points at the test patch on the latex wall, serious.

clips.text: ¿Cómo sabes si tu pared es mineral? La prueba de la gota. Le tiras unas gotas de agua. Si resbalan como en un vidrio, hay plástico.
clips.action: he flicks a few drops of water from his wet fingers onto the cream latex wall, the drops beading and running down.

clips.text: Si se chupan y la pared se oscurece, es mineral. Ahí la cal se va a agarrar.
clips.action: he flicks water drops onto a bare scraped patch of grey plaster, the drops soaking in and darkening it.

clips.text: Si tu pared tiene pintura vieja, hay que sacarla o, por lo menos, sacar todo lo que está flojo, hasta ver el repello.
clips.action: he scrapes the old latex paint with a wide putty knife, a flake curling off.

clips.text: Y sobre yeso pintado tampoco. Eso no te lo dicen en los videos: te lo digo yo, para que no tires tu dinero.
clips.action: he taps a smooth white gypsum wall on the other side of the room and shakes his head.
